subject: Bluewave Therapeutics — SSO/SCIM artifacts and RBAC sampling scope
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@bluewave.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluewave.com
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request — SSO/SCIM exports + RBAC sampling window

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our SIG intake we're trying to assemble a narrow set of artifacts to validate provisioning and entitlement controls for Redwood's hosted offering. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by EOD Thursday (our audit window):

1) A SCIM delta extract (CSV) covering 30 days, with timestamps and operation types.
2) Representative SAML assertion samples (ideally 5 examples showing different NameID formats and eduperson attributes).
3) A snapshot of RBAC role-to-permission mappings and a small sample (50 accounts) showing role assignments.

We're looking to scope this tightly — Bluewave will redact any PII we shouldn't see. If you have a standardized artifact checklist or a protected link for uploads, send that over and we'll ingest.

Thanks,
Alex Reed
Director, IT Risk — Bluewave Therapeutics

Attachments: none (we'll accept Secure Upload link)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@bluewave.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SSO/SCIM exports + RBAC sampling window

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for but want to confirm a couple of scope points so we don't overdeliver sensitive data: 

- SCIM delta: we can produce a 30-day delta export scoped to Bluewave tenant only (will include user.id, userName, active, meta.lastModified, and the operation type). Is CSV acceptable or do you prefer JSON?
- SAML assertions: we'll sanitize attributes — we can provide five assertion examples showing different bindings and a short explanation for each.
- RBAC snapshot: we'll provide a mapping file and a 50-user sample; we recommend streaming the sample via a secure Share link (we control redaction).

Irene, can your team generate the SCIM extract and a RBAC snapshot? Markus — can you include the role mapping doc and a short note on least-privilege controls (role design, owner attestations)?

Proposed timeline: deliver initial upload to a restricted Drive folder by 2026-09-10 18:00 PT, with a short walkthrough call on 2026-09-11 10:00 PT if that works for you.

Sofia Ivanova
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
(she/her)

Attachments: none

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Alex Reed <alex.reed@bluewave.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SSO/SCIM exports + RBAC sampling window

Hi all,

Per Sofia's ask, attached are three stub artifacts to validate format and content before we produce the full package:

- scim_delta_sample.csv (30 rows) — includes operation types (create/update/patch/delete), timestamps, and userName. Redacted email fields replaced with user<n>@redacted.
- saml_assertion_examples.txt — five assertions (headers only, with attribute name/value pairs) illustrating transient vs persistent NameID and eduperson attributes.
- rbac_scope_snapshot.json — mapping of roles -> permissions (sample subset) and a 50-user assignment sample. Note: the JSON is a small export; the full mapping will be a spreadsheet.

A few notes on least-privilege and owner attestations:
- Roles are scoped by product surface (api, console, infra) and split into admin/editor/viewer tiers.
- Role owners conduct quarterly attestations; we keep attestations in Confluence with stable timestamps.
- Service accounts are flagged and rotated every 90 days; we exclude service account secrets from exports.

I'll upload the full SCIM delta (CSV) and a complete RBAC spreadsheet to the restricted Drive link by 2026-09-10 17:30 PT. Can you confirm the Secure Upload link or share an SFTP endpoint if preferred?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Product Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- scim_delta_sample.csv (text/csv)
- saml_assertion_examples.txt (text/plain)
- rbac_scope_snapshot.json (application/json)

From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@bluewave.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluewave.com
Date: 2026-09-10T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SSO/SCIM exports + RBAC sampling window

Irene / Sofia — received, thanks. The sample artifacts look good and the formats match what our assessors expect. A couple quick follow-ups before your full upload: 

- For the SCIM delta, please include the meta.version or an operation sequence id if available — our tooling uses that to reconstruct events.
- In the RBAC spreadsheet, can you add a column for 'role_owner_email' and a boolean 'service_account' flag per account row?
- For SAML assertions, a brief line describing how NameID formats are chosen per IdP would be helpful.

If you can include those fields in the final drop we'll close out this evidence set and schedule the walkthrough for Friday. We're OK with the Drive link. I'll have our security ops confirm the upload target after this message.

Regards,
Alex Reed
Director, IT Risk — Bluewave Therapeutics
